title: CardioLM: A multilingual suite of small language models for the cardiology domain
abstract: arXiv:2611.07940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Cardiovascular care generates large volumes of clinical free-text documentation in local languages. However, clinical natural language processing (NLP) resources remain concentrated in English, and no existing benchmark is cardiology-specific, multilingual, and broad in entity coverage.   Methods: We present two contributions. The first is CardioCCC, a corpus of 508 cardiology case reports originally published in Spanish and extended to Czech, Dutch, English, Italian, Romanian, and Swedish through machine translation, annotation projection, and clinician review, with annotations covering diseases, symptoms, procedures, and medications. The second is CardioLM, comprising CardioBERTa, a set of language-specific encoders obtained by continued pretraining on cardiology and biomedical corpora, and CardioNER, a set of named entity recognition (NER) models fine-tuned on CardioCCC.   Results: Cardiology-specific pretraining reduced

translated_title: CardioLM：面向心脏病学领域的多语言小型语言模型套件
translated_abstract: 背景：心血管诊疗会在本地语言中产生大量临床自由文本文档。然而，临床自然语言处理（NLP）资源仍集中于英语，且目前尚无心脏病学专用、多语言且实体覆盖广泛的基准。方法：我们提出了两项贡献。第一项是 CardioCCC，一个包含 508 份心脏病学病例报告的语料库，这些报告最初以西班牙语发表，并通过机器翻译、标注投影和临床医生审核扩展至捷克语、荷兰语、英语、意大利语、罗马尼亚语和瑞典语，其标注涵盖疾病、症状、操作和药物。第二项是 CardioLM，包括 CardioBERTa——一组通过对心脏病学和生物医学语料库进行持续预训练而得到的特定语言编码器，以及 CardioNER——一组在 CardioCCC 上微调的命名实体识别（NER）模型。结果：心脏病学专用预训练降低了……
tldr: 该研究提出了多语言心脏病学病例语料库 CardioCCC 以及小型语言模型套件 CardioLM（含编码器 CardioBERTa 和命名实体识别模型 CardioNER），填补了心脏病学领域多语言临床 NLP 资源的空白。
en_tdlr: This study introduces CardioCCC, a multilingual corpus of cardiology case reports, and CardioLM, a suite of small language models including CardioBERTa encoders and CardioNER models, filling the gap of multilingual cardiology-specific clinical NLP resources.
